title: Eric Weinstein: Revolutionary Ideas in Science, Math, and Society
summary: Eric Weinstein is a mathematician, economist, physicist, and managing director of Thiel Capital. He formed the “intellectual dark web” which is a loosely assembled group of public intellectuals including Sam Harris, Jordan Peterson, Steven Pinker, Joe Rogan, Michael Shermer, and a few others . Video version is available on YouTube .
